Five traits sit in the open. The sixth is a charm behind glass.

$LOCKET is a token on Pons. Each piece carries five public traits and one sealed charm. The charm is encrypted in your own browser with AES-256-GCM before anything is sent, so the chain only ever holds ciphertext and a commitment. The key is wrapped for Lit Protocol V3, where an immutable Lit action asks the chain who owns the piece right now, over a pinned RPC, and hands the key back only to that wallet.

Sell the piece and the same locked charm moves with it. Nothing gets resealed, and the new holder opens it. A former holder may keep anything they already opened, because glass cannot unsee.

Built with Lit Protocol. Until a real end-to-end test passes, buying, minting and Lit access stay closed, and every charm stays latched.
